Two findings ahead of US-3045: (1) the refine pass records ZERO cache reads - its system block is under the cache minimum and the large per-category tool schema is not under a breakpoint; (2) tag OCR runs on 4% of items because it only sees tag/tag_2-roled photos. kit spend still n=0: cross_post_channels still NULL for this seller, or the kit call failed - check the edge log for 'kit filled' / 'cross-list kit failed'. | 2026-09-02 fourth run: AFTER n=3 drafts / 5 generations, single-item cold-cache runs (operator cannot run a batch now; accepted as the AFTER for this gate). Coverage 65% vs 55%. Theme 0/3, Fabric Type 2/3, Country 1/2, Features 1/3, Product Line 0/1, Model 0/1. tag_ocr n=0 (no tag-roled photos on any of the five). Ledger cache-cold: $0.116/draft = autolister $0.07 + refine $0.02 + size $0.01 + measure $0.02. CONCLUSION: the refine pass is $0.01-0.02/draft, not the lever; generation ($0.05-0.07) and, before the cap, size ($0.07) are. US-3045 re-ranked behind US-3047. Open question on Theme: whether it survives the MAX_AI_ASPECTS=45 demand cut on these leaves (coverage counts it; the schema may not) - needs the cached leaf payload. Gate considered met on cost; NOT met on fill quality (n=3).

userStories.title: Observe once: the aspect-refine pass runs text-only on the observations the generation pass already made
userStories.description: As the operator paying for AutoLister, I want the generation pass to emit a compact structured observation of the garment and the refine pass to fill specifics from that text on the lightweight model, so that the second vision call and its ~7,500 image tokens per item go away without the specifics getting worse.
acceptanceCriteria: LISTING_GEN_TOOL gains an optional visual_observations object (fabric_construction, neckline, sleeve_length, closure, pattern, fit, printed_text, graphics_or_characters, hardware, lining, notable_features: string[]) behind a listing_gen_v3 prompt version registered in CODE_PROMPT_TEXT; v1/v2 output is unchanged (byte-identical prompt pinned).

When the generation result carries visual_observations, extractEbayAspects is called with photos: [] and a new observations block in buildAspectUserPrompt; the model is getHaikuModel() (text routing) regardless of isEasyAspectCategory. Without observations the current photo path runs unchanged.

Shadow gate before activation: lib/listing-eval.ts (or a new scripts/refine-shadow.ts) runs BOTH refine paths on the same 50 golden items and reports per-aspect agreement and fill counts; the text path may go live only if recommended-tier fill count is >= the photo path's and disagreement on required aspects is < 2%. Numbers go in this story's note.
ai_enrichment_log.suggested_fields.listing_gen records refine_mode: 'photo' | 'observations' and the refine token split, so the saving is readable per item.
The US-3044 gate story has its post-change numbers in its note before this story's prompt version is activated.
userStories.notes: 2026-09-02: re-ranked from 12 to 60. The US-3044 ledger shows the refine pass at $0.01-0.02 per draft against $0.05-0.07 for generation; removing its images saves a tenth of the bill, not half. Do US-3047 first (cache breakpoints on the refine schema, tag-role coverage), then re-measure.

userStories.title: Two per-draft cost lines the ledger exposed: refine-pass cache reads sit at zero, and tag OCR reaches 4% of drafts
userStories.description: As the operator paying for AutoLister, I want the aspect-refine call to hit the prompt cache on the per-category tool schema and the tag-OCR pass to run on the label photo of most items, so that the two cheapest wins the 2026-09-02 ledger showed ($0.148 per draft) are taken before the observe-once refine (US-3045) is argued.
acceptanceCriteria: AutoLister's refine call tags the ledger as feature 'autolister_refine' (a new enterAiFeature value) so it is separable from the one-item extract path that shares 'catalog_extract'; scripts/aspect-fill-report.ts lists it.

extractEbayAspects places a cache_control breakpoint on the LAST tool definition when caching is enabled, so the per-category tool schema (up to MAX_AI_ASPECTS aspects with up to MAX_ALLOWED_VALUES_PER_ASPECT values) is the cached prefix; a unit test pins the breakpoint on the tool and on the system block.

After a batch of 30+ items on prod, aspect-fill-report.ts shows median cache_read_tokens > 0 for 'autolister_refine' and the median $/call for that feature at or below the BEFORE catalog_extract median ($0.01); numbers go in this story's note.

processBatch assigns photo roles before generation when an item has no photo roled tag/tag_2: ai-photo-roles.ts (lightweight model, ~512 output tokens) runs once per such item, its cost lands in the item's ai_enrichment_log row, and it is skipped when every photo already carries a role.

After the same 30+ item batch, the ledger shows tag_ocr running on >= 60% of drafts (BEFORE: 11 of 295), and the Country of Origin / Garment Care / Product Line fill rates in the AFTER table are compared against BEFORE in this story's note.

userStories.title: Extension: show the cross-listing queue, lead the popup with the work, and put the read button on the toolbar
userStories.description: The unified extension has drained the server-side work queue every five minutes since US-2481 and never showed a row of it. A seller who queues six cross-posts from their phone opens the laptop to no count, no list, no way to start them, and no sight of the rows that expired or failed — which GET /api/flipdesk/extension-queue has been returning in needsAttention the whole time. Alongside that, the Selling tab opened on the scheduled-poll clickwrap and the sold-sync table (two blocks about how the extension runs) above the two queues with a deadline on them, and the Reads tab could only DESCRIBE the condition read: the primary action had three doors and none of them was the toolbar icon.
acceptanceCriteria: The popup Selling tab renders the cross-listing queue: every pending and claimed row with its kind, platform, age and state, plus every expired/failed row with the reason it will not run. An unanswerable queue renders as unknown, never as empty.
"Run these now" calls the same drainQueue the five-minute alarm calls, under the same seller gates, and says what it started without claiming completion.

Cancel is offered on a queued row only and Dismiss on a failed/expired one; a claimed row offers neither, because DELETE /:id would remove a job out from under a marketplace tab that is mid-fill. Pinned by test/queue-view.test.cjs.

The Selling tab opens on a work summary (to end / queued / to update) that jumps to each block, and the nav badge is the SUM of the three, written once after all three renders settle. A count that could not be read is never rendered as zero.
The Selling panel is ordered urgent → recent → machinery → reference; the channel table collapses with its live count on the summary.
The Reads tab carries a "Get condition read" button that runs the read on the active tab through the same worker path as Alt+G, disabled with a reason when the tab is not a supported listing.
timeAgo accepts an ISO string as well as an epoch number: the pending-delist and pending-revise blocks passed server ISO timestamps into a number-only helper and rendered "NaNd ago" on every row.
GET /api/flipdesk/extension-queue joins the item title onto each row (owner-scoped, non-fatal, not on the /claim hot path) so the popup and the Marketplaces page can name what is queued.
The web queue card no longer offers Cancel on a claimed row, and describes revise/relist rather than calling both "List to <platform>".
userStories.notes: [BUILT 2026-09-02] New: extension-unified/queue/queue-view.js (pure view model, shared by popup + worker) and test/queue-view.test.cjs (11 groups; asserts cancel is queued-only, failures count toward the badge, every dead row carries a reason, and KIND_LABELS matches the edge EXTENSION_QUEUE_KINDS). background.js gains getQueue/cancelQueueRow and the GT_QUEUE_STATE / GT_QUEUE_CANCEL / GT_QUEUE_RUN_NOW / GT_CC_RUN_ACTIVE handlers (internal only — deliberately NOT in EXTERNAL_TYPES). manifest background.scripts + importScripts updated in lockstep. popup.html/js/css: work summary, queue block, reordered Selling panel, collapsed Channels with live count, Reads action button, footer link to the options page. Edge: flipdesk-extension-queue.ts withItemTitles() on GET only. Web: use-extension-queue.ts item_title, marketplaces.tsx claimed-row Cancel removed + revise/relist described + rows named. Verified with a stubbed-chrome Playwright render of popup.html at 340px on both tabs; 47/47 extension guards, tsc -b and eslint clean.

userStories.title: EPIC: extension as the moat - the grade on every listing a shopper sees, and the honest answer to cloud automation
userStories.description: As GradeThread, we want the unified browser extension (extension-unified/, v1.1.0, Chrome + Firefox + Edge) to carry features no crosslister can copy, so that installing it is the obvious choice for buyers and sellers and the grade becomes visible on every marketplace listing. Competitors (Vendoo, List Perfectly, Crosslist, Nifty) sell cross-listing and cloud automation; per vault/60-decisions/adr-no-server-side-marketplace-automation.md we will never hold a marketplace session, so we win on trust data instead: the certificate badge on live listings, seller honesty from the condition index, a persistent work surface, a worker tab that drains the queue all day, on-device pre-reads, an MCP tool so Claude can queue listing work, flip mode on sourcing sites, the return evidence pack on the eBay return page, in-browser background removal, and a label reader.
acceptanceCriteria: Umbrella only: this story closes when every child passes. Children are filed immediately after it and named in the closing AC below

Standing constraint (ADR, vault/60-decisions/adr-no-server-side-marketplace-automation.md): no child stores a marketplace credential or cookie, requests the cookies permission, runs a marketplace action outside the seller's own browser, or answers a CAPTCHA. A child that needs any of those is rejected, not adapted

Standing constraint (US-3042, extension-unified/test/ebay-no-scrape.test.cjs): the eBay path reads nothing off the page but the item id. Any child touching eBay keeps that test green without editing it

Standing constraint (vault/30-platform/extension-injected-ui-isolation.md): every injected surface lives in a shadow root via research/overlay-host.js and ships its CSS through scripts/gen-extension-overlay-css.mjs; extension-unified/test/overlay-shadow.test.cjs and theme-css.test.cjs stay green

Standing constraint (vault/40-growth/extension-funnel-attribution.md): no child hand-builds a gradethread.com link; every link goes through extension-unified/attribution.js and extension-unified/test/attribution.test.cjs stays green
Standing constraint (US-2020, extension-unified/test/legacy-parity.test.cjs): no child adds a feature to extension/ or extension-condition/; they take bug fixes only

Every child that adds an edge route on a multi-tenant table scopes it with .eq on c.get('workspaceOwnerId') ?? c.get('userId') or an owner-verified parent row and adds a case to services/edge-functions/src/tests/tenant-isolation_test.ts (US-268)
Every child that ships a new extension behaviour adds a zero-dependency node test under extension-unified/test/*.test.cjs that scripts/test-extensions.mjs discovers, and npm run verify passes
Order of work: US-2727 and US-2718 (the two live production breaks) land before any child here ships to the stores; a child may be built behind them but the store upload waits
Children: US-3060, US-3061, US-3062, US-3063, US-3064, US-3065, US-3066, US-3067, US-3068, US-3069, US-3070, US-3071. This epic closes when all twelve pass

userStories.title: Verified badge on live listings: show the GradeThread certificate on the marketplace page every extension user is looking at
userStories.description: As a shopper with the extension installed, I want a listing that was graded through GradeThread to show its certificate grade right on the eBay, Poshmark or Mercari page, so that I can trust that listing over the one next to it; and as a seller, I want my graded listings to look better inside every shopper's browser, so that grading pays for itself. This is the install loop: every badge is an ad for the certificate and a reason to grade. Today the research overlay (extension-unified/research/*) only grades from photos on click; it never asks whether a certificate already exists.
acceptanceCriteria: New unauthenticated route GET /api/grading/public/listing-certificates?platform=<ListingPlatform>&ids=<comma list, max 24> on services/edge-functions/src/routes/public-grading.ts, behind publicReadLimiter('grading-public') like the other public reads (main.ts around line 943). It joins listings.platform + listings.platform_listing_id (src/types/database.ts ListingRow) through the inventory item to grade_reports.certificate_id and returns, per id found, only: certificate_id, grade_value, tier label, graded_at, and the certificate path. It fetches no page, no image and no listing URL; it reads only rows already public (grade reports with a certificate_id are public per CLAUDE.md)

A listing whose seller has opted out is omitted: migration adds flipdesk_settings.listing_badge_opt_out boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false (US-1108 triple: idempotent SQL, EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION bumped in the same commit, self-record footer; PENDING_MIGRATIONS.md entry; NOTIFY pgrst reminder). A switch on src/pages/flipdesk/marketplaces.tsx reads and writes it and tolerates a missing column until the apply, the way review_flow_enabled does (US-9204)

The extension asks for badges only from ids it already has without scraping: on eBay the item id from the URL via ebayItemIdHere() in research/selectors.js (US-3042 test stays green, unedited); on Poshmark and Mercari the listing id from the URL path and, in scan mode (US-2237), the card hrefs it already collects (SCAN.cardKey in research/marketplace.js). One batched request per page load, never per scroll; a second request on the same tab within 60 seconds is refused client-side (test)

On a detail page with a hit, the overlay bar shows the grade, the tier and 'Graded by GradeThread' with a link to the certificate built through attribution.js (utm_medium=badge); in scan mode a matching card gets a small badge next to the existing claimed-vs-price badge. Both render inside the existing shadow root (research/overlay-host.js) and the CSS lands in scripts/gen-extension-overlay-css.mjs, not a stylesheet

The badge never appears on a listing without a hit, and a 4xx/5xx or network failure renders nothing (no 'unverified' badge: absence is not a claim). extension-unified/test/listing-badge.test.cjs pins the id extraction per platform, the batch cap, the 60-second refusal and the render-nothing-on-error rule with a fake fetch

Analytics: extension usage telemetry (usage-telemetry.js, opt-in, OFF by default per vault/20-domain/extension-telemetry-consent.md) gains one counter, badge_shown, with no listing id and no URL. The site side registers badge_certificate_click in src/lib/analytics-events.ts (drift guard test passes) for the certificate page arrival

Certificate page (src/pages/certificate.tsx or the Pages Function in functions/ that SSRs it) shows a one-line 'Seen via the extension on <platform>' note when utm_medium=badge, with the existing install CTA (src/components/marketing/extension-install-cta.tsx) hidden when the bridge marker says the extension is installed

Tenant and privacy: the route exposes nothing keyed by user id and accepts no user id; services/edge-functions/src/tests/tenant-isolation_test.ts gains a case proving an opted-out seller's listing id returns no row and that ids from two sellers in one request return only public fields

OPERATOR: with a graded item listed to eBay and Poshmark from a test account, open both listings in Chrome and Firefox with the 1.1.x build and confirm the badge, the certificate link and the scan-mode badge; flip the opt-out and confirm both disappear on reload

userStories.title: Worker tab: a pinned GradeThread tab that drains the cross-listing queue all day, and the same drain on Firefox for Android
userStories.description: As a seller, I want to leave one GradeThread tab open and have my queued list, delist, revise and relist jobs run through the day without me clicking anything, so that I get what Nifty sells (work happens while I am not watching) without handing anyone my marketplace login. Today background.js drains on the gt-lister-sweep alarm every 5 minutes and on startup only, the MV3 service worker sleeps between alarms, and the seller has no surface that says 'the drain is running'. The manifest already declares gecko_android strict_min_version 142, so Firefox on Android can run the same drain from the seller's own phone; nobody in the category has that.
acceptanceCriteria: New extension page extension-unified/worker.html + worker.js, opened by the popup ('Keep GradeThread working') via tabs.create with pinned:true and never from a content script (no web_accessible_resources rule). While it is open it holds a runtime.connect port to background.js so the service worker stays alive, and asks for a drain on a 60-second setInterval through the existing GT_QUEUE_RUN_NOW path; the 5-minute gt-lister-sweep alarm stays as the fallback when the tab is closed

The page shows the same grouped queue the popup shows (reuse extension-unified/queue/queue-view.js: needs you / running / waiting), a live 'last drain HH:MM, next in Ns' line, and a Stop button. A job that needs a human (CAPTCHA, login wall, the US-2482 human-check) pauses the drain and the page says which tab needs the seller, in the words the popup already uses; the drain never resumes on its own until the seller clicks Resume (ADR: no CAPTCHA solving, ever)

The drain runs at most one job at a time and only in tabs the worker opened itself; it refuses to run in a tab it did not open (test). Marketplace tabs opened by the worker close themselves on job completion; a tab still open 10 minutes after its job's deadline alarm (JOB_ALARM_PREFIX in background.js) is reported, not killed

Depends on US-2727: the story cannot close while completion writeback (listings.listed_at NOT NULL) still fails, because a drain that cannot record a success would loop. AC: 20 consecutive drains against a seeded queue on the local stack (docker start supabase_rest_gradethread supabase_kong_gradethread per CLAUDE.md) complete every row exactly once, asserted from extension_work_queue rows

Firefox for Android: the manifest's gecko_android block is kept, host-permissions.js's fail-open probe is used on first run, and the worker page is reachable from the popup on Android Firefox. Per platform (Poshmark, Mercari, Grailed, Vinted) the lister adapter is verified on the mobile web DOM; where the mobile DOM differs from the desktop selectors in lister/selectors.js, the adapter refuses with a 'run this on desktop' sentence rather than guessing (US-2165 fail loudly), and lister-selectors.test.cjs pins which platforms are mobile-enabled
Options page gains 'Start the worker tab when the browser opens' (default off); when on, runtime.onStartup opens the pinned tab. Stored in storage.local like the other options (no storage.sync)

extension-unified/test/worker-tab.test.cjs covers: interval drain calls, port keep-alive reconnect after a service-worker restart, refusal to act in a foreign tab, pause-on-human-check, and that the tab never navigates to a URL that arrived in a message it did not build itself (US-1876 rule)

Mobile clients: the QUEUED_NOTICE copy (services/edge-functions/src/lib/extension-queue.ts, byte-identical across clients per US-2481) is extended in one place to mention the worker tab and Firefox on Android, and the four mirrors (web, iOS, Android, extension) are updated in the same commit with the existing byte-identical test

OPERATOR: on a Chrome desktop and on Firefox for Android 142+, queue one list and one delist from the phone app, open the worker tab, and confirm both complete without a click; record which platforms passed on mobile in this story's notes

userStories.title: Side panel work surface: the queue, the item card, comps and the grade next to any marketplace tab
userStories.description: As a seller working inside Poshmark or Mercari, I want a panel that stays open beside the page with my queue, the item I am listing, its grade and its comps, so that I stop bouncing between the popup, FlipDesk and the marketplace. Every competitor uses a popup that closes on the first click; Chrome and Edge ship chrome.sidePanel and Firefox ships sidebar_action, and extension-unified/manifest.json deliberately uses neither today (permissions: storage, activeTab, alarms, contextMenus).
acceptanceCriteria: manifest.json adds the sidePanel permission and side_panel.default_path = panel.html for Chromium; scripts/package-extensions.mjs firefoxManifest() converts that to sidebar_action {default_panel, default_title, default_icon} and strips side_panel, with a test in extension-unified/test/manifest-hosts.test.cjs or a new firefox-manifest.test.cjs proving both zips carry exactly one of the two keys

The panel opens only from the action button on a host in the lister or research match lists (background.js calls sidePanel.setOptions({tabId, enabled}) per tab; on other hosts the action keeps opening popup.html). Firefox has no per-tab option, so on Firefox the sidebar renders a 'open a marketplace tab' state on other hosts

panel.html reuses, not copies, the popup modules: queue/queue-view.js for the grouped queue with Retry / Retry all / Clear failed / Cancel all waiting / Run these now (US-3048), popup.js's sign-in state, and theme.js. A new panel/item-card.js renders the FlipDesk item the seller is listing: the grade (or a 'not graded' link), the certificate, the target price, and the sold comps from the existing GET /api/flipdesk/pricing or comps route the review page uses (src/pages/flipdesk/review.tsx names it); the item is found by the job that is running or was last completed in that tab

On a Poshmark or Mercari listing that belongs to the seller (research/own-listing detection, own-listing.test.cjs) the panel shows that listing's FlipDesk item and offers Revise and Relist through the existing GT_LISTER_REVISE and GT_LISTER_RELIST messages, disabled with the selectors.js reason string when the platform block is enabled:false

Every network call from the panel goes through background.js message types that already exist (GT_QUEUE_*, GT_LISTER_*, GT_SYNC_*); the panel holds no token and makes no fetch of its own (test asserts panel/*.js contains no fetch( call, the ebay-no-scrape.test.cjs source-assertion pattern)
Accessibility: extension-unified/test/popup-a11y.test.cjs is extended to panel.html (landmarks, labelled controls, focus order); scripts/extension-a11y.mjs runs it
Theme: panel CSS is generated by the same pipeline as popup-theme.css (scripts/gen-extension-theme-css.mjs) so theme-css.test.cjs fails on drift; System/Light/Dark from options (US-3055) applies

OPERATOR: on Chrome, Edge and Firefox, open a Poshmark listing from a signed-in test account, open the panel, run a revise from it, and confirm the queue row appears and completes; record the per-browser result in the notes

userStories.title: Selector snapshot fixtures: catch a marketplace redesign in CI the day it lands
userStories.description: As the extension maintainer, I want a saved, sanitised copy of each marketplace form and listing page checked into the repo and a test that resolves every selector in lister/selectors.js and research/selectors.js against it, so that a Poshmark or Mercari redesign fails the build instead of failing every seller's run silently (the US-1875 delist regression shipped because nothing could exercise the DOM without a logged-in human). Today selector health is only observable live (Check selectors in the popup, US-2484) and enabling any flow requires a person with an account.
acceptanceCriteria: New operator script scripts/capture-selector-fixture.mjs <platform> <flow> that attaches to a running Chrome via Playwright's connectOverCDP (the operator is logged in; no credential is read or stored), serialises document.documentElement.outerHTML of the current tab, and sanitises it before writing: every img src and srcset replaced by a 1x1 data URI, every input value emptied, every script tag removed, any string matching the seller's handle or email (passed as --redact) replaced, and the file written to extension-unified/test/fixtures/dom/<platform>/<flow>.html with a JSON sidecar {capturedAt, selectorsVersion, url path only}
A gitleaks run on the fixture directory is part of the capture script's exit path; a fixture that trips it is deleted before the script exits non-zero

New Playwright spec e2e/extension-selectors.spec.ts (own project in playwright.config.ts, no dev server needed) loads each fixture with page.setContent, runs the selector resolution functions from lister/selectors.js and research/selectors.js (exported the way lister-selectors.test.cjs already imports them), and asserts every selector in an enabled:true block resolves to at least one element and every selector in a research adapter finds the gallery, title and price. A platform block with enabled:false is skipped and listed in the report, never failed
The spec also asserts the fixture sidecar's selectorsVersion equals the platform's version in selectors.js; a selector bump without a recapture fails with 'recapture <platform> <flow>'

npm run verify's e2e lane (node scripts/verify.mjs --e2e) runs the spec; the Playwright browser is the pre-installed one (executablePath from PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH), and the spec runs in under 30 seconds on the fixtures shipped

Fixtures captured for at least: poshmark list form, poshmark listing detail (delist), mercari list form, mercari listing detail, vinted list form, grailed list form, plus research detail pages for Poshmark, Mercari, Grailed, Vinted and Depop. eBay has no fixture on purpose (US-3042: the eBay path reads nothing off the page) and the spec says so

public/extension/marketplace-selectors.json (the remote config background.js fetches, config-sync.test.cjs) is resolved against the same fixtures in the same spec, so hosted and bundled selectors are both proven
OPERATOR: capture the eleven fixtures above from a logged-in test account and commit them; the story cannot close on a synthetic fixture

userStories.title: Seller honesty in the overlay: state how far this seller's claims sit from the grade, from the condition index
userStories.description: As a shopper, I want the overlay to tell me that this seller overstates condition more often than the marketplace average, or less, so that scan mode stops being a price check and becomes a trust check no marketplace offers. US-2708 (market condition index) aggregates the claimed-vs-actual gap per read; this story is the extension surface for it, and US-2239 seller memory already shows my own pattern for a seller on-device. Gated: nothing here ships until US-2709's question to counsel is answered, per the epic's operator AC.
acceptanceCriteria: Depends on US-2709 (counsel answer) and US-2710 through US-2713 (the index children). This story does not build aggregation; it reads the public route those children publish (GET /api/grading/public/condition-index/* in services/edge-functions/src/routes/public-grading.ts, lib/condition-index.ts)

The overlay (research/overlay-host.js render path) gains one line under the read: 'Sellers on <marketplace> claim <tier> when the grade says <tier> about N% of the time' from the marketplace/category aggregate, and only when the route returns a sample at or above its stated minimum; below it, the line is omitted (never 'not enough data' in the overlay, per lib/resale-condition.ts's null rule)

A per-seller rate appears only where US-2148's asymmetry allows: penalise only human-confirmed reads, credit on either. The extension never computes a per-seller rate itself; it shows a number only if the route returns one for that seller key, and the seller key is the marketplace handle hashed client-side with the same function seller-memory.js uses so the server never receives a plain handle (test)

The line is worded from a fixed table in research/condition-format.js with a test (scan-format.test.cjs pattern) covering every band; no free-text from the server is rendered (US-9111 untrusted-string rule applies to overlay copy too)

Scan mode (US-2237) badges a card with the seller line only on hover, never in the grid by default, so a search page does not become a wall of judgements; options page gains 'Show seller honesty on cards' default off

extension-unified/test/seller-honesty.test.cjs pins: omitted below sample, hashed seller key, fixed wording table, and that own-listing detection (own-listing.test.cjs) suppresses the line on the seller's own closet
OPERATOR: after US-2709 closes, confirm with counsel's answer in hand which of AC2 and AC3 may ship, and note the decision on this story before any code merges

userStories.title: MCP tool to queue extension work: 'list my new items on Poshmark' from Claude, drained by the seller's own browser

userStories.title: On-device pre-read with Chrome's Prompt API: an instant, free, private first look before the certified grade
userStories.description: As a shopper, I want an instant first look at a listing's photos that runs entirely inside my browser and costs nothing, so that scan mode feels immediate and I only spend a paid read when it is worth it; as GradeThread, we want every listing's obvious defects triaged on the shopper's machine so Claude Vision spend goes down. Chrome 138+ exposes the Prompt API (LanguageModel, Gemini Nano) to extensions with image input arriving in newer builds; Firefox has nothing equivalent, so this is progressive and the server read stays the only thing ever called a grade.
acceptanceCriteria: New module extension-unified/research/local-model.js with detect() (returns available / downloadable / unavailable from LanguageModel.availability(), and unavailable on Firefox or any browser without the global), and preRead(images, hints) that creates a session with a fixed system prompt and a JSON output schema {defects: [{kind, where, confidence}], claimed_tier_plausible: bool, note: string} and returns null on any error or when the model says it cannot see the images. No network call anywhere in the module (source-assertion test: the file contains no fetch(, XMLHttpRequest, or importScripts)

The pre-read runs only for adapters that already hand images to the research overlay (Poshmark, Mercari, Grailed, Vinted, Depop) using the same image list image-utils.js builds. eBay is excluded because the eBay path reads nothing off the page (US-3042); on eBay the pre-read runs, if at all, on the image URLs the server's /grade-from-url response returns, after the read, so ebay-no-scrape.test.cjs stays green unedited

The overlay shows the pre-read as 'Quick look (on your device)' with the defects list, and never a number, never the word grade, never a tier; the wording table lives in research/condition-format.js with a test that the strings 'grade' and any digit-dot-digit pattern do not appear in quick-look copy. The existing 'Check condition' button stays the only path to a grade and is unchanged

In scan mode (US-2237) with the option on, the pre-read runs for at most 6 cards per page and only for cards whose first image is already loaded in the DOM (no extra image fetch); the result adjusts nothing in the price-vs-claim badge and adds only a small 'quick look' marker that opens the defects list

Options page gains 'Quick look on this device' (default on where detect() is available, hidden where it is not) and a 'Download the on-device model' action that calls LanguageModel.create() with a download progress monitor; the model download is never triggered silently on a content script

Server-side, POST /api/grading/public/grade-from-url accepts an optional pre_read object from the extension and stores it on the read for calibration (US-2708 pipeline, listing-ingest.ts), never uses it as an input to the grade (grading-engine skill: the prompt inputs are unchanged, so no prompt version bump), and the extension sends it only when usageTelemetry is on (vault/20-domain/extension-telemetry-consent.md)

extension-unified/test/local-model.test.cjs stubs a global LanguageModel and covers: unavailable path returns null, schema parse failure returns null, eBay exclusion, the 6-card cap, and that the quick-look copy never contains a grade

OPERATOR: on Chrome 138+ with the on-device model downloaded, open a Poshmark listing with a visible pill on the fabric and confirm the quick look names it before the paid read; on Firefox confirm the option is hidden and nothing else changes

userStories.title: Flip mode on sourcing sites: should I buy this, on ShopGoodwill and GoodwillFinds
userStories.description: As a reseller sourcing online, I want the 'Should I flip this?' read (US-2238 flip mode: shadow grade + eBay comps, margin after fees, days to sell, buy or pass) on the sites where I actually buy inventory, so that the margin decision happens at the point of purchase. Flip mode today only injects into the six resale marketplaces in extension-unified/manifest.json; no crosslister runs anything on a sourcing site.
acceptanceCriteria: Research adapters for shopgoodwill.com (item pages /item/<id>) and goodwillfinds.com (product pages) in extension-unified/research/selectors.js with assetIdPattern, gallery, title, price and the current-bid field for auctions, each carrying verified:false until the operator AC below sets lastVerified; manifest.json content_scripts and host-permissions.js gain both hosts and extension-unified/test/manifest-hosts.test.cjs proves the three lists agree

POST /api/flipdesk/scout/appraise-url (services/edge-functions/src/routes/flipdesk-scout.ts around line 545) accepts the two hosts in its marketplace field and, per the anti-crawl contract in lib/listing-ingest.ts, fetches only the image URLs the extension sends, never the page; a test in services/edge-functions/src/tests asserts a request naming either host with a page URL and no images is refused

A 'Watch this lot' action on an auction page saves the item id and the flip verdict on-device in storage.local (no server row) and the popup lists watched lots with their verdict; the extension never bids, never auto-refreshes the page, and never navigates to a lot on its own (test, US-1876 rule)

userStories.title: Return shield: the grade evidence pack on the eBay return page itself
userStories.description: As a FlipDesk seller looking at an item-not-as-described return in eBay Seller Hub, I want the extension to show me the evidence pack GradeThread already assembled (dated grade report, the disclosure the listing carried, the drafted response) right there, so that I answer the case from the page I am on instead of finding the item in FlipDesk first. US-2703's children built the pack (US-2704 publication snapshots, US-2705 matcher, US-2706 return evidence and review surface); this is the extension surface for it, under the epic's honesty constraints: no surface claims evidence wins a case, no draft cites a defect the grade report does not contain, and a pack that would prove an undisclosed flaw refuses to assemble.
acceptanceCriteria: New content script extension-unified/research/return-shield.js matched only on eBay Seller Hub return and case URLs (ebay.com/sh/rtn/*, ebay.com/sh/cases/*, and the returns detail path; the exact match list is pinned in manifest-hosts.test.cjs). It reads the return id and the item id from the URL only, never from the page (extend ebay-no-scrape.test.cjs's source assertion to this file without weakening it)

The script asks background.js (new GT_RETURN_PACK message) for the pack; background.js calls POST /api/flipdesk/ebay/returns/:returnId/evidence with a preview flag (flipdesk-ebay.ts around line 6567, and /evidence/preview at 6509) using the extension token through extensionOrUserAuthMiddleware (middleware/extension-or-user-auth.ts); the route already scopes to the workspace owner and the tenant-isolation case is extended for the extension-token path

The overlay (shadow root, overlay-host.js) shows: the verdict from US-2705 (assemble / refuse-undisclosed / no-report), the dated report summary, the disclosure snapshot, the drafted paragraph with a Copy button, and 'Open in FlipDesk' through attribution.js. On refuse-undisclosed it shows the US-2703 sentence telling the seller to consider a refund and offers nothing to copy

Nothing is submitted to eBay by the extension: no form is filled, no button on the eBay page is clicked, no file is attached. Sending evidence stays on the FlipDesk post-sale surface (US-2706) where the eBay API does it. A source-assertion test proves return-shield.js contains no click(, no form submit and no input value assignment
Copy rule: no string in the overlay says or implies the case will be won; the wording table lives in research/condition-format.js with a test that the words win, guaranteed and reversed do not appear
A return for an item the account did not sell (no listing row for that item id under the workspace) renders nothing, and the request is not retried on that tab (test with a fake fetch returning 404)
extension-unified/test/return-shield.test.cjs covers URL parsing, the three verdict renders, the no-submit assertion and the 404 path

OPERATOR: on a real eBay return for an item graded and published through FlipDesk (the same case the US-2703 epic is waiting on), open Seller Hub with the extension and confirm the pack renders; note the outcome on both stories

userStories.title: Label reader from the context menu: right-click a tag photo, get brand, size, RN and style code
userStories.description: As a shopper or seller looking at a care-tag photo on any site, I want to right-click it and have GradeThread read the brand, size, fibre content, RN and style code, so that I can check a listing's claims or start an item without retyping a label. userStories.description: As a seller, I want a price or description change in FlipDesk to reach Poshmark, Mercari, Grailed and Vinted, and a relist to run from the button, so that the extension channels stay in sync the way the eBay channel does. userStories.title: EPIC: command-center overviews - GradeThread Dashboard, FlipDesk Overview and iOS Home as a widget board the seller lays out
userStories.description: As a seller, I want the three home surfaces (/dashboard, /dashboard/flipdesk and the iOS Home tab) to show what needs me first and let me choose, size and arrange the widgets, so that the page is my command center instead of a fixed column of cards. Since US-2537 (dashboard) and US-2547 (overview) shipped, the product added Offers and Messages, Returns and Disputes, Scheduled drops, AutoLister, Automations, the extension queue, sync conflicts, payouts, ad spend, inventory equity, forecast, consignment, verified profiles, the time-saved meter (US-9207) and the review flow (US-9204). Neither web overview surfaces any of them, and the only ranked needs-you list (src/components/flipdesk/needs-you-card.tsx) is mounted on post-sale only. No server-side UI-layout preference exists today: sidebar collapse is localStorage (src/components/dashboard/sidebar.tsx:169), the pipeline WIP limits are a persisted Zustand store, and nothing else remembers how a seller wants a page laid out.
acceptanceCriteria: Umbrella only: this story closes when every child passes. Children are filed immediately after it and named in the closing AC below

Standing constraint: widget ids are stable strings namespaced grading.* and flipdesk.*, declared once in src/lib/dashboard-widgets.ts; iOS uses the same ids for the sections it shares (the ProductSurface.id precedent at ios/GradeThread/Tools/ProductSurfaces.swift:16). A renamed id is a migration of stored layouts, not an edit

Standing constraint: no new dependency for drag. @dnd-kit/core and @dnd-kit/sortable are already in package.json and the idiom is src/components/flipdesk/photo-manager.tsx (DndContext + SortableContext + rectSortingStrategy + arrayMove). If a child imports @dnd-kit/utilities it declares it in package.json (today it is only transitive)

Standing constraint (US-2547): the FlipDesk board keeps ONE aggregate RPC, flipdesk_overview_metrics, for every number it carried before; no widget reads items_full or loops rows in the browser; src/test/overview-stage-and-range.test.ts stays green

Standing constraint (US-2537): in every default layout the seller's own data precedes every promotional widget; src/test/dashboard-own-data-first.test.ts is ported to assert the exported default layouts rather than JSX order, with the same intent
Standing constraint: npm run ui:check stays at zero. A widget frame declares elevation once (border, no shadow), carries no coloured side tab, and no drag animation uses bounce easing

Every widget renders inside src/components/error-boundary.tsx and a Suspense skeleton, so one failing widget never blanks the page; a render test throws inside one widget and asserts the others still paint

Children: US-3073 (board foundation), US-3074 (customize mode), US-3075 (GradeThread Dashboard on the board), US-3076 (FlipDesk Overview on the board), US-3077 (FlipDesk action widgets), US-3078 (FlipDesk money and health widgets), US-3079 (attention rail), US-3080 (iOS Home layout). This epic closes when all eight pass

userStories.title: Attention rail: one strip above both overviews that ranks what needs the seller now, with last-updated and refresh-all
userStories.description: As a seller, I want a single line at the top of the overview that says how many things need me and which is due first, and lets me refresh everything at once, so that the overview works like a command center before I scroll. userStories.title: iOS Home tab laid out as a command center: attention strip, period picker, a section model the seller can reorder and hide, shortcut tiles, two columns on iPad
userStories.description: As a seller on the phone, I want Home to open on what needs me and on the numbers for the window I care about, and to be able to reorder or hide its sections, so that Home is worth opening. Today ios/GradeThread/Dashboard/DashboardView.swift is a fixed VStack: activation checklist, a 2x2 KPI grid over a hard-coded 7-day window, the revenue sparkline, an Analytics link row, a Certified grades link row, five aging rows and five stacked full-width quick-action buttons that take a whole screen. userStories.title: Standing Scout: saved sourcing triggers that sweep eBay every 15 minutes and push a buy-now alert
userStories.description: As a FlipDesk seller, I want to save a sourcing trigger (keywords, brand, category, and either a max total price or a minimum margin) that keeps watching new eBay listings while I am away, so that I get a push the moment an underpriced item appears and can buy it before another reseller does.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration adds scout_triggers (user_id, label, query, brand, category_id, max_total_cents nullable, min_margin_pct nullable, min_grade nullable, active, last_swept_at, hits_count) and scout_trigger_hits (trigger_id, user_id, ebay_item_id, total_cents, asking_cents, shipping_cents, shadow_grade, margin_pct, url, alerted_at) with a UNIQUE (trigger_id, ebay_item_id), RLS user_id = auth.uid() on both, and the US-1108 triple (idempotent SQL, EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION bumped in the same commit, self-record footer)

New GateFlags key scoutTriggers in services/edge-functions/src/lib/pricing-config.ts plus a numeric scoutTriggersMax per plan (free 0, starter 0, pro 5, business 20), and the SAME commit ships the pricing_plans migration that writes the flag into every existing gate_flags row, because a key missing from the DB row resolves to false for everyone (see the NOTE above the autolister flag)

CRUD routes GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/flipdesk/scout/triggers in routes/flipdesk-scout.ts, tenant-scoped to c.get('workspaceOwnerId') ?? c.get('userId') on every query, gated by requireFlipdesk({feature:'scoutTriggers'}); creating a trigger past scoutTriggersMax returns 402 with the plan-gate body; routes/tenant-isolation_test.ts gains cases for all four verbs plus the viewer-role refusal

New cron POST /api/jobs/scout-triggers (requireJobSecret + acquireJobLock, mounted under /api/jobs/* in main.ts) registered in COOLIFY.md on */15 * * * * so services/edge-functions/src/tests/cron-registry-drift_test.ts passes; one sweep groups active triggers by (query, brand, category_id) and issues ONE Browse item_summary/search per group with sort=newlyListed and filter buyingOptions:{FIXED_PRICE|BEST_OFFER}, so 40 triggers on 12 distinct searches cost 12 calls, not 40

Daily Browse call budget for the sweep is a system_settings value (default 2000) read via getSetting; when the budget is spent the sweep exits early with skipped:'budget' and records the fact in cron_runs, and a unit test proves the sweep stops at the budget with no further ebayFetch calls

Total price = asking price + the cheapest shippingOptions.shippingCost from the item summary (0 when free shipping); a listing whose shipping cost is absent from the summary is compared on asking price alone and the hit row stores shipping_cents null, never 0

A max_total_cents trigger fires when total price <= max_total_cents; a min_margin_pct trigger fires when the condition-adjusted margin from scoreCandidate (lib/scout-scoring.ts, using cachedValueAtGrade) is >= min_margin_pct; a min_grade trigger additionally requires the shadow grade >= min_grade so a cheap-because-ruined listing is skipped, and each of the three modes has its own unit test with a listing just above and just below the line

Every hit inserts scout_trigger_hits and the UNIQUE index dedupes: the same eBay item never alerts twice for the same trigger, proven by a test that runs the sweep twice over the same fixture and sees one push

Each new hit calls notifyUser with a new NotifyInput type scout_trigger_hit (with its own notification_preferences key so it can be muted) and a transactional push helper pushScoutTriggerHit in lib/transactional-push.ts with category scout.trigger_hit and data { kind: 'scout_trigger_hit', triggerId, ebayItemId, url }; the push body names the item, the total price and the threshold it beat (e.g. 'Arc'teryx Beta AR at $62 total, under your $80 cap')

Shadow grading of trigger hits draws from the seller's AI-action quota through reserveAiActionSafe like /appraise does; when the quota is exhausted the sweep still evaluates max_total_cents triggers (no AI needed) and skips margin/grade triggers with a once-per-day notification saying why

The web sourcing page src/pages/flipdesk/sourcing.tsx gains an 'Alerts' tab (?tab=alerts) that lists triggers with a toggle, an edit sheet, the hit count, and a hits feed where each row opens the eBay listing in a new tab; free and starter plans see the tab with an upgrade prompt instead of a create button

The hits feed and the push deep link open the eBay listing URL returned by the Browse API for that item (itemWebUrl), never a search page; tapping the push on web routes to /dashboard/flipdesk/sourcing?tab=alerts&hit=<id>
The sweep is off until the ops flag scout_triggers_sweep_enabled in lib/feature-flags.ts is on (fail-closed), and PENDING_MIGRATIONS.md lists the two migrations
userStories.notes: 2026-09-03: the manual Scout scan gets the same total-price rule (asking plus cheapest shippingOptions.shippingCost, null when absent) under US-3098, implemented once in lib/scout-scoring.ts so trigger hits and manual scans agree.

userStories.title: eBay Partner Network: affiliate attribution on every outbound eBay link from Scout, Prospect and trigger alerts
userStories.description: As the operator, I want every eBay listing link that GradeThread hands a seller (Scout results, Prospect comps, Standing Scout alerts) to carry eBay Partner Network attribution, so that a purchase made through our alert earns a commission on top of the subscription.
acceptanceCriteria: OPERATOR: apply at partnernetwork.ebay.com for an eBay Partner Network (EPN) publisher account naming gradethread.com and the FlipDesk app as the properties, create one campaign for FlipDesk sourcing, and store the campaign id in Coolify as EBAY_EPN_CAMPAIGN_ID (reference only, value never written to the repo); vault/10-ops/env-reference.md gains the row and the runbook note says approval typically takes days and needs a live site with real traffic

OPERATOR: read the EPN rate card and program terms at approval time and record in the same vault note the apparel commission rate, the per-item cap, and the click-to-purchase attribution window, dated, so the margin math is checkable and re-checkable

When EBAY_EPN_CAMPAIGN_ID is set, searchBrowseComps and both newlyListed searches in lib/ebay-client.ts send the header X-EBAY-C-ENDUSERCTX: affiliateCampaignId=<id>,affiliateReferenceId=<ref> and map itemAffiliateWebUrl into the result's url field, falling back to itemWebUrl when eBay omits it; when the env var is unset the header is NOT sent and a unit test asserts both branches on a recorded fixture

affiliateReferenceId is an opaque per-user token (HMAC of the user id under an existing server secret, truncated), never the raw user uuid or email, so eBay's click reports cannot be joined to a person without our key; a test asserts the value is not the uuid

The Scout results, Prospect comps, and the Standing Scout hits feed and push (US-3081) all use the url field, so the affiliate link flows through with no per-surface link building; grep for '/itm/' string-building in src/ and the edge returns nothing new

Disclosure: the sourcing page and the alerts tab carry a one-line 'GradeThread may earn a commission when you buy through these eBay links; it never changes the price you pay' note, and src/pages/legal/privacy.tsx plus the terms page state the EPN relationship, per FTC endorsement guidance and the EPN terms

The browser extension (extension-unified) is EXPLICITLY excluded: its links stay plain and it sends no affiliate parameter, because EPN treats browser extensions and toolbars as software applications needing separate pre-approval, and an extension guard test in extension-unified/test fails if 'campid' or 'mkcid' or 'affiliateCampaignId' appears in the extension bundle

Attribution reporting: a nightly job or the existing analytics path records EPN click and purchase counts from the EPN reporting export (manual CSV import is acceptable for v1) into a gt_epn_reports table so the admin revenue page can show commission next to subscription revenue; if EPN offers no API at build time, the AC is met by the CSV importer and a vault note saying so
userStories.notes: 2026-09-02: EBAY_PARTNER_ACCOUNT_SID and EBAY_PARTNER_AUTH_TOKEN are ALREADY SET on the Coolify edge service (names only; values live in Coolify). These are the eBay Partner Network Reporting API credentials (Account SID + Auth Token pair), so AC8's click/purchase report import can call the reporting API directly instead of a CSV import. They are NOT the campaign id: link attribution (AC1/AC3) still needs an EPN campaign id, to be stored as EBAY_EPN_CAMPAIGN_ID once the EPN account and campaign exist. Buyer-side check done the same day: no buyer web surface (src/pages/buyer, src/components/buyer) links out to an eBay listing URL today, and the extension stays excluded on both the buyer and seller sides (EPN software-application rule), so there is no buyer-side link work in scope. | 2026-09-02: EPN campaign EXISTS. Campaign id = 5339154788 (campid= in the EPN link generator output; not a secret, it is in every public link). Link anatomy for reference: mkcid=1 (channel = EPN), mkrid=711-53200-19255-0 (eBay US rotation id, siteid=0), toolid=10001 (link generator), customid= is the slot for our per-user reference (AC4), and ssspo/sssrc/ssuid/stype/widget_ver/media are eBay share-widget tracking that the Browse API affiliate URL will not carry and we do not need. Still to do: set EBAY_EPN_CAMPAIGN_ID=5339154788 on the Coolify edge (AC1) and confirm the account is approved, not just created. | 2026-09-03: the iOS open path is US-3097 (UIApplication.open on the url field so the eBay app takes the universal link; no ebay:// scheme). Its last AC asks for the dated EPN-terms check on in-app purchase credit, which belongs in the vault note AC1 here creates.

userStories.title: Extension: a Standing Scout alert opens the eBay listing with the Flip panel already run
userStories.description: As a FlipDesk seller who tapped a Standing Scout alert, I want the listing to open with the extension's Flip panel already expanded and showing the verdict against my trigger, so that the buy decision takes one look and one click instead of a second round of tapping.
acceptanceCriteria: The alert URL (US-3081 hits feed and push) carries a fragment #gt-flip=<triggerId> appended to the eBay item URL, and extension-unified/research/marketplace.js reads it on load: when caps.sellerEnabled is true it calls the flip section's appraise path without the CTA click and scrolls the panel into view; when sellerEnabled is false the fragment is ignored and the overlay behaves exactly as today

The auto-run happens at most once per page load and never on a plain listing URL without the fragment, proven by a test in extension-unified/test that loads a fixture DOM with and without #gt-flip and counts calls to the appraise-url endpoint (1 and 0)

The Flip panel shows a 'Matched your trigger: <label>' line with the threshold beaten (max total price or minimum margin) when the fragment names a trigger the seller owns; the trigger label is fetched through GET /api/flipdesk/scout/triggers/:id and a 404 or 403 renders the panel with no trigger line rather than an error

An 'Add to inventory' button in the Flip panel posts to /api/flipdesk/scout/buy with the trigger id in the body, and /buy records trigger_id on the inventory_items row's acquisition metadata so the seller's Money tab can later show profit per trigger; tenant-isolation_test.ts gains the case for a trigger id the caller does not own (403, no write)

When the extension is not installed, the web alerts tab shows a one-time dismissible banner 'Get the buy-or-pass verdict on the listing itself' linking to the install funnel from US-1757; the dismissal persists in localStorage and the banner never shows on iOS or Android web views

The extension adds NO affiliate parameters to any link (US-3082 keeps the eBay Partner Network attribution server-side and out of the extension); the existing extension guard set passes and the bundle contains no 'affiliateCampaignId' string
extension-unified/README.md and TESTING.md document the #gt-flip fragment and the manual test on a live eBay listing, and the adapter version in marketplace-selectors.json is bumped

userStories.title: iOS and Android: Standing Scout triggers and alert handling at parity with the web
userStories.description: As a FlipDesk seller on my phone, I want to create and manage sourcing triggers and tap a trigger alert straight into the listing, so that the feature that only matters when I am away from my desk actually works away from my desk.
acceptanceCriteria: iOS: a Triggers screen under Tools next to Scout lists, creates, edits, toggles and deletes triggers through the /api/flipdesk/scout/triggers routes, using the shared client's plan-gate handling so a 402 shows the upgrade sheet with the action disabled (the US-1374 posture); an XCTest covers list decoding, the 402 branch and the trigger form validation (a trigger needs a query and exactly one of max total price or minimum margin)
Android: the same screen in Kotlin/Compose under scout/, through EdgeApi so the 402 reaches the shell's plan-gate dialog (US-1367), with JUnit cases mirroring the iOS ones

userStories.title: Lululemon size-dot rim: decode a transcription that starts mid-circle, and re-run the backfill on undecoded codes
userStories.description: As a seller, I want a Lululemon size dot to decode wherever the OCR started reading around its circular rim, so that the style number reaches the listing instead of a raw rim string. Evidence from the 2026-09-02 backfill (US-3085) on prod: 10 Lululemon items got a code, 5 decoded (M3BF7S, M5609S, M7AK1S, M7BA0S, W5DLXS) and 5 were filed raw because the rim was transcribed from a random start point: S7502T9LM4C847, LW3DUTS224000011302, LW5EGTS253, 0000F80000DLW5B0303, ERNSFD78042289140204. Each contains the L?[WM]xxxxC style number as a substring. styleCodeSpellings (lib/listing-style-code.ts) only tries dot-separated prefixes and one confusable letter slot; a rim that wraps has no dots at the right places.
acceptanceCriteria: styleCodeSpellings (or a Lululemon-scoped sibling) also tries the rotations of a long rim string: every window that matches the pack's anchored style-number shapes, in the order the decoder specs already define, and only inside a pack that carries decoders. Test: the five raw strings above each decode to a six-character canonical code; a Nike DD1391-100 and an unknown-brand ABC-123 are unchanged.

The decoder bar holds: the rotation search runs only inside an already-resolved pack (it re-confirms the pack's brand, never recovers one), and vault/20-domain/brands/brand-kb-decoder-bar.md gains a dated paragraph saying why a substring search is acceptable here and nowhere else (same commit).

scripts/backfill-tag-reads.ts gains --redo-undecoded: items whose attributes.mpn does not decode under their brand pack are re-planned from the stored mpn WITHOUT a new OCR call (no spend), and the canonical code replaces the raw one on attributes.mpn and the MPN / Style Code aspect only where the aspect still carries the raw value (inventory_derived provenance).
OPERATOR: run the backfill with --redo-undecoded --dry-run, confirm the five items above decode, then --apply, and paste the summary into this story's note.
userStories.notes: [2026-09-02] AC1-AC3 BUILT AND MERGED to main (af90ccc44, merged as a no-ff merge). Verified on main after the merge, not only in the worktree: deno test src/tests/listing-style-code_test.ts + tag-read-backfill_test.ts = 25 passed, 0 failed; deno lint clean over 1942 files; npm run vault:lint strict exit 0. WHAT SHIPPED: styleCodeRimWindows() + rimDecoderSpecs() in lib/listing-style-code.ts, tried only AFTER whole-string spellings and only inside an already-resolved pack; planRedoUndecodedPatch() in lib/tag-read-backfill.ts; a --redo-undecoded pass in scripts/backfill-tag-reads.ts that re-plans from the STORED mpn with no new OCR call and no spend; a dated section in vault/20-domain/brands/brand-kb-decoder-bar.md recording why a substring search is admissible inside a pack and nowhere else. ⚠ AC1 IS NOT FULLY MET, AND THE STORY'S PREMISE IS WRONG FOR TWO OF THE FIVE. Three decode: LW3DUTS224000011302 -> W3DUTS, LW5EGTS253 -> W5EGTS, 0000F80000DLW5B0303 -> W5B03O (via the existing confusable slot, 0 read as O). Two provably cannot, and were left undecoded on purpose rather than forced: S7502T9LM4C847 has exactly one W/M, the M of LM4C847, which forces the colour slot onto the trailing 7 - no decoder shape accepts a digit there, 7 is not in CONFUSABLE_LETTER, and all 26 letters fit that slot equally, so a decode would invent a character nobody printed. ERNSFD78042289140204 contains no W and no M in any rotation, so no anchored Lululemon shape can match any window; confirmed by brute-forcing every window of every rotation with and without one substitution. The description's claim that each of the five contains L?[WM]xxxxC as a substring is FALSE for these two. Both are asserted in the test as unchanged WITH the reason, and the refusal is recorded in the vault callout so a later session does not widen CONFUSABLE_LETTER to make them pass - that would file a style code nobody printed into the MPN aspect and into the learned index. A FOURTH GUARD was added that the ACs did not ask for: a window containing no digit is rejected, because without it WOMENS matches style_number_2017 exactly and any label prose landing in the style-code field would have decoded. --redo-undecoded also canonicalises a code that decodes but was stored in another spelling (US-2714's one-spelling-per-garment rule), which is slightly wider than AC3's literal wording and is documented in the script header. No migration was needed and none was written. STILL OPEN: AC4, the operator backfill run (--redo-undecoded --dry-run, then --apply), and the AC1 remainder is now a decision rather than a task - either accept 3 of 5 as the ceiling for a rim with no anchor, or re-photograph those two tags.

userStories.title: [GATE] SERP-check the ten head terms behind the listing generator, the Vinted leg and the buyer-trust leg
userStories.description: As the operator, I want to know which of the ten head terms in docs/seo/keyword-strategy-2026-09-02.md still return clickable links and who holds their top ten, so that the three new legs are built against results pages that have results. US-9026 made query shape a build criterion: a 500/mo tool noun without an AI Overview beat a 50,000/mo question with one, nine of thirteen target SERPs carried one, and nobody has checked these ten.
acceptanceCriteria: Ten terms checked in a browser, signed out, US, desktop, one sample each, appended to docs/seo/serp-feature-audit-2026-08-28.md in its existing table format with the date: ebay listing template, ebay description template, ebay title builder, depop description template (leg 2); how to sell on vinted, vinted scams (leg 3); is vinted legit, is mercari legit, is poshmark legit, is depop legit (leg 4).

For each term: AI Overview present yes/no, whether the Overview renders the deliverable inline (a usable template, a full how-to, a verdict), organic link count above the fold, and the top ten domains each classified as marketplace help centre, template vendor, major publisher (DA 80+), small blog, or UGC (Reddit, Quora, YouTube, TikTok).

LEG 2 VERDICT written under a new "Gate results" heading in docs/seo/keyword-strategy-2026-09-02.md: BLOCKED only if ebay listing template AND ebay description template both carry an Overview that renders a usable template inline AND none of the top ten on either is a static template site. Otherwise OPEN, naming which of the four terms still return links.
LEG 3 VERDICT in the same section: BLOCKED only if the Vinted help centre holds every page-one organic slot on how to sell on vinted. Otherwise OPEN, naming the reachable slots.

LEG 4 VERDICT in the same section, PER TERM: a term is OPEN only if at least one of its top ten is a small blog or UGC (something a page with no links can displace). Record the four verdicts separately; the buyer hub story builds only the OPEN ones.

The downstream stories are reprioritised from the verdicts in the same commit: a BLOCKED leg has its stories moved to priority 900+ with a note naming this story, an OPEN leg keeps its priority. No story is deleted.
The note records the caveat from US-9026 verbatim in spirit: one sample per query, Overview presence varies by user and time, re-run with the quarterly pull US-9016 schedules for 2026-11-18.

userStories.title: Anonymous listing-draft endpoint: one to three photos in, a marketplace-ready title, item specifics and description out, nothing stored
userStories.description: As a seller who searched for an eBay listing template, I want to drop a photo of the garment and get a real title, item specifics and description written for the marketplace I pick, so that I see the product do the job instead of reading a template. Reuses the AutoLister prompt (generateListingFields in services/edge-functions/src/lib/ai-listing.ts) on the hardened anonymous pattern that /api/grading/public/grade-check and /api/grading/public/tag-read already use in services/edge-functions/src/routes/public-grading.ts. Source: docs/seo/keyword-strategy-2026-09-02.md finding A (the how-to phrasings are blank, the tool nouns carry 4,000/mo and the best bids in the file).
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/grading/public/listing-draft is unauthenticated and accepts 1 to 3 image data URLs plus optional brand, size, condition and a target of ebay, poshmark, mercari or depop; a fourth image or an unknown target returns 400 with a named error code, mirroring parseScanBody in lib/extension-scan.ts. The parser and the response shaper live in a new pure module services/edge-functions/src/lib/free-listing-draft.ts with its own _test.ts, no hono and no supabase import.

Every image passes validateImageUpload then stripImageMetadata before the model sees bytes (lib/upload-validation.ts, lib/image-metadata.ts), each capped at 8MB like tag-read; the endpoint persists no image, no draft and no row in any table, and services/edge-functions/src/tests/tenant-isolation_test.ts gains a case asserting an anonymous call leaves inventory_items and listings row counts unchanged.

Rate limited at 3 calls per IP per hour via a sibling of gradeCheckRateLimited returning 429 with code rate_limited, and reserves against reserveGlobalDailyBudget (lib/ai-limiter.ts) returning at_capacity when the daily ceiling is spent; both branches unit tested.

The call reuses generateListingFields with a promptSelectKey for the free tool rather than a second prompt, is attributed via enterAiFeature so its spend reads as its own line in the AI cost tracking, and the response carries no comps, no price and no eBay category id (those need an account and the comps path is tenant-scoped).

For target ebay the returned title passes lintTitle (lib/title-lint.ts) with zero errors and is at most 80 characters; for the other three targets the title is trimmed to that marketplace title limit with title-trim.ts and the response names the limit it was cut to. The description is rendered through description-render.ts blocks, so the free output and the paid output share one house style.

A run log line [free-listing-draft] records target, image count, model latency and the lint result, never the title text or the image, so cost per call is measurable from the log without storing anything.

deno test on the new _test.ts and tenant-isolation_test.ts passes, deno lint and deno check pass, and the endpoint is exercised once end to end against the local edge (EDGE_ENV=test PORT=8787) with a real photo before the story closes, with the response shape pasted into the story notes.

userStories.title: The listing generator page at /tools/listing-generator: copyable templates per marketplace plus the photo-to-listing demo, handing off to AutoLister
userStories.description: As a seller searching ebay listing template, ebay description template, ebay title builder or depop description template, I want a page that gives me a copyable template for my marketplace and, if I drop a photo, writes the actual listing, so that I get the template I searched for and see why the product beats one. Every incumbent on these SERPs is a static HTML template site from the Auctiva and inkFrog era; the page ships the template half regardless and the generator half when the endpoint is live, so a killed generator never leaves an empty shell (the calculators.ts status flag rule).
acceptanceCriteria: A Calculator entry in src/lib/seo/calculators.ts with slug listing-generator, audience seller, status live, story set to this id, and handoff surface autolister with copy that says what AutoLister does for a whole closet; src/lib/seo/__tests__/calculators.test.ts and calculator-funnel.test.ts pass unchanged in their rules.

Registered in PUBLIC_ROUTES and ROUTE_LAST_MODIFIED in src/lib/seo/public-routes.ts, in src/prerender/entry-server.tsx, and in the router, so public-routes.test.ts, route-page-modules-exist.test.ts and the prerender sync guard pass; the page prerenders with the template tabs visible in the static HTML (a grep of dist shows the eBay template text).

Four tabs, eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, each with a copyable title pattern and description template whose character limits and field names are read from MARKETPLACE_SPECS in src/lib/constants.ts rather than typed by hand, with a test in src/lib/__tests__/ asserting every rendered limit equals the constant.

A photo drop zone (media-intake, the grade-checker pattern) posts to /api/grading/public/listing-draft and renders the title with a live character count against the tab limit, item specifics as a list and the description; a 429 rate_limited renders the limit message and a 503 at_capacity renders the capacity message, never the try-a-clearer-photo copy (US-2526).
The AutoLister handoff renders only after a result or below the templates, never above them, and the handoff click fires the same event calculator-funnel.test.ts pins for the fee calculators.

Keyword rows in src/lib/seo/keyword-targets.ts: primary ebay listing template, secondary ebay description template, ebay title builder, ebay listing generator, depop description template, poshmark listing template, mercari description template; the route title carries the primary and keyword-targets.test.ts passes. src/lib/seo/extension-cta-copy.ts carries three page-specific lines for the new /tools path so src/test/extension-install-cta.test.ts passes.

JSON-LD matches the other tools (the type the calculators emit plus FAQPage with at least three questions from the keyword rows), jsonld-schema-lint.test.ts and json-ld.test.ts pass, npm run ui:check reports zero enforced findings, and npm run verify is green before the commit.

Measured at 8 weeks, 2026-11-15, in this story's notes: impressions and CTR for the seven keyword rows, mobile and desktop split, and handoff clicks; baseline is zero because the URL is new. Under 100 impressions at position 30+ is a competition problem and gets written down, not fixed by adding pages.
